name: Minted Lamb Steaks – Air Fryer
ingredients: 4 lamb leg steaks, approximately 150-200 g each
20 g fresh mint, tender stalks included
1-2 tbsp water, only if needed to loosen the marinade

steps.text: Put the fresh mint and garlic into the mixing bowl and chop 3 sec / speed 8. Scrape down the sides.
Add the olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, honey, English mustard, rosemary, flaky sea salt, MSG and black pepper. Mix 10 sec / speed 5.
If the marinade is very thick, add 1-2 tbsp water and mix 5 sec / speed 4.
Coat the lamb steaks thoroughly in the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for a stronger flavour.
Remove the lamb steaks from the refrigerator 20-30 minutes before cooking.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C. Shake or scrape off any very heavy excess marinade so the honey does not burn, leaving the steaks well coated.
Air fry at 200°C, turning halfway: approximately 8 minutes for pink to medium, 9-10 minutes for medium, or 11-12 minutes for more well done. Cooking time will vary with thickness.
Rest the lamb steaks for 5 minutes before serving.
